title: Pope Paul VI issues the encyclical Populorum progressio.
text: An encyclical is primarily associated with papal encyclicals in the Catholic Church, letters outlining the church's perspective on a topic. Still, it is also used among Anglicans and the Eastern Orthodox Church.

title: The first French nuclear submarine, Le Redoutable, is launched.
text: Le Redoutable was the lead boat of her class of ballistic missile submarines in the French Marine nationale. Commissioned on 1 December 1971, the boat was the first French SNLE (Sous-marin Nucléaire Lanceur d'Engins, "Device-Launching Nuclear Submarine").

title: The SEACOM Asian telephone cable is inaugurated.
text: SEACOM is a telephone submarine cable linking Hong Kong with Malaysia. Its telephone link was opened in 1967.

title: Torrey Canyon oil spill: British Fleet Air Arm and Royal Air Force aircraft bomb and sink the grounded supertanker SS Torrey Canyon.
text: The Fleet Air Arm is the naval aviation component of the United Kingdom's Royal Navy (RN). The FAA is one of five RN fighting arms.

title: A United Nations delegation arrives in Aden as its independence approaches. The delegation leaves April 7, accusing British authorities of lack of cooperation. The British say the delegation did not contact them.
text: The United Nations is an international intergovernmental organization established by the signing of the Charter of the United Nations on 26 June 1945 with the articulated mission of maintaining international peace and security, developing friendly relations among states, promoting international cooperation, and serving as a center for harmonizing the actions of states in achieving those goals. title: Martin Luther King Jr. denounces the Vietnam War during his sermon at the Riverside Church in New York City.
text: Martin Luther King Jr. was an American civil rights activist and Baptist minister who was a prominent leader of the civil rights movement from 1955 until his assassination in 1968.
